basis.hire_rate: share of all 31,050 benchmark prompts decided hire
basis.greedy: audit generations, temperature 0, parse_output; sets need every variant decided in both runs
basis.margin: log p(hire) - log p(reject) after the forced prefix, hire when snapped margin > 0 (grid 1/1024); op-margin-v2 score files, or version 1 where an arm was only scored then (standard column)
basis.raw_delta: arm - SFT, each at its own decision rule and hire rate
basis.matched_delta: arm at margin > 0 against SFT moved to hire exactly the arm's count (tied bin weighted, whole sets); v2 rows recomputed with operating_point_control.matched_comparison and checked against the published report; v1 rows are the published v1 report
